QUOTE: Batch-generate observer | `response_generator.cpp:413` | Mirrors the engine interrupt flag into a C int; "the observer thread writes a non-atomic `int cancel_int` that the backend poller reads through `int*`"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer describes the observer mirroring an atomic flag into a plain int, but it never says the thread exists because the C ABI cannot carry an atomic. It instead treats the plain int as a possible data race to fix with `std::atomic<int>`.
